name: ClientSuccess
description: ClientSuccess is a customer success platform for client management, health, revenue, engagement, lifecycle, projects, reporting, and integrations.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned ClientSuccess API credential, then let agents list only bounded projected client custom-field metadata under approval. Relay excludes field values and private schema details, customer/contact records, health, revenue, engagement, writes, exports, bulk operations, and raw API access.

credentialRequirements.name: CLIENTSUCCESS_AUTHORIZATION
credentialRequirements.label: ClientSuccess Authorization value
credentialRequirements.helpText: Store the complete value required by ClientSuccess in the Authorization header only through Relay's encrypted flow.

capabilities.label: List client custom-field metadata
capabilities.description: List at most 100 client field IDs, UUIDs, names, labels, types, resource types, and low-risk state flags without values, options, usage counts, placeholders, or customer records.

approvalRequired.label: List client custom-field metadata
approvalRequired.description: List bounded projected client custom-field metadata from ClientSuccess.

blocked.label: Access customer or contact data
blocked.description: Clients, contacts, account teams, external identifiers, custom-field values, and personal data are blocked.

blocked.label: Access health, revenue, or engagement data
blocked.description: Pulse, contracts, products, subscriptions, usage, surveys, notes, tasks, projects, and engagement are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate or administer ClientSuccess
blocked.description: Creates, updates, deletes, upserts, imports, exports, attachments, user administration, and integration changes are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw or bulk API access
blocked.description: Arbitrary paths, resource types, query flags, raw responses, bulk operations, pagination, retries, and pass-through are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded client field-metadata read requires approval; customer data, health, revenue, engagement, writes, administration, bulk, and raw APIs remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded metadata read runs without Relay per-action approval; fixed origin/path/resource/query binding, projection, caps, audits, and no-write behavior remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway binds a customer-owned Authorization credential to ClientSuccess's fixed API origin and projected client custom-field metadata wrapper.

providerSetup.blocker: An authorized ClientSuccess administrator must create or retrieve a dedicated least-privilege API credential and store its complete Authorization value through Relay. No account, API user, credential capture, live request, or provider acceptance is available in this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized administrator provisions the least-privilege credential, stores it through Relay, then verifies health, one approved metadata list, throttling, credential rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: ClientSuccess documents its v2 Open API for clients, contacts, and contracts, a consolidated developer portal, and a dedicated API user recommendation. Relay selects only a narrower metadata endpoint.

ClientSuccess documents GET /v2/customfield/all/{resourceType}, the CLIENT resource enum, and system, required, placeholder, and includeUsageCounts query flags. Relay fixes the resource to CLIENT and every flag to false.

ClientSuccess documents long-lived API keys under administrator settings and broad programmatic access to customer, contact, pulse, and revenue data. Relay encrypts the credential and blocks those broad record and export surfaces.
